يستذنب (form X)
# يَسْتَذْنِبُ (yastaḏnibu) /jas.tað.ni.bu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَذْنَبَ (istaḏnaba)
# يُسْتَذْنَبُ (yustaḏnabu) /jus.tað.na.bu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَذْنَبَ (istaḏnaba)
# يَسْتَذْنِبَ (yastaḏniba) /jas.tað.ni.ba/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَذْنَب
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
